user.title: Sonarr & Radarr Library
user.description: All five services are optional — leave a service's URL blank to skip it entirely, as long as at least one is filled in. The name fields only affect this setup step; they set the entity/device name (and therefore entity_id) and can't be changed later, only the URLs/API keys can (via Configure).

data_description.qbittorrent_api_key: Generate one in qBittorrent's WebUI settings. Preferred over username/password.
data_description.jellyfin_url: e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8096. Watch dates are read for every Jellyfin user visible to the API key, not just one.
data_description.jellyfin_api_key: Create one under Dashboard > API Keys in Jellyfin.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the URL and make sure the service is reachable.
error.required_with_url: An API key is required when a URL is set.
error.required_with_key: A URL is required when an API key is set.
error.no_services_configured: Fill in at least one of Sonarr, Radarr, Maintainerr, qBittorrent or Jellyfin. Jellyfin only adds last-watched dates to the Maintainerr sensor, so it has no effect unless Maintainerr is also configured.
error.qbit_auth_required: Fill in either a qBittorrent API key, or both a username and password.

abort.already_configured: This combination of services is already configured.
